# Classmarker

ClassMarker is a professional, flexible, and easy-to-use online quiz maker for business and education, offering customizable exams, instant grading, and detailed reporting.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/classmarker/.

## Actions

- **Create a new question category**: Create a new question category.
- **Create ClassMarker User**: Create a new user in ClassMarker.
- **Create Group**: Create a new group.
- **Create Question**: Create a new question with specified text, type, and category.
- **Delete API Key**: Delete an API key by its ID.
- **Delete Group**: Delete a group by its ID.
- **Delete User**: Delete a specific user by ID.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a specific webhook listener.
- **Get All Groups, Links, and Exams** (read-only): Retrieve all available groups, links, and their exams.
- **Get Group Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific group.
- **Get Question** (read-only): Retrieve a specific question by its ID.
- **Get Recent Results For Group Exam** (read-only): Fetch recent test results for a specific group and exam.
- **Get Recent Results Link Exam** (read-only): Fetch recent results for a specific link and exam.
- **Get Test Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific test.
- **Get User Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific user.
- **List Assignments** (read-only): List all assignments.
- **List Certificates** (read-only): List all certificates.
- **List Groups** (read-only): List all groups in your ClassMarker account.
- **List Question Categories** (read-only): Retrieve all question categories.
- **List Questions** (read-only): List all questions.
- **List Recent Results For Groups** (read-only): Retrieve recent exam results for all groups.
- **List Recent Results for Links** (read-only): Retrieve recent exam results for all links.
- **List Tests** (read-only): List all available tests.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all configured webhooks.
- **Update Question**: Update an existing question in the question bank.
- **Update Sub-Category**: Update an existing sub-category.
- **Create Access List Item**: Add one or more access codes to an access list.
- **Delete Access List Item**: Delete one or more codes from an access list.
- **Delete Test Link**: Delete a specific test link.
- **Get Initial Finished After Timestamp**: Compute the initial finishedAfter timestamp.
- **Update an existing parent category**: Update an existing parent category.
